description.value: Taste of Tokyo is a family-owned Japanese restaurant in the waterfront town of Sidney, BC, serving authentic sushi, noodle dishes, and Japanese-Western fusions crafted by a head chef with over a decade of experience. The kitchen emphasizes fresh, locally sourced ingredients and a personalized community-oriented approach that has earned it a loyal local following. The full-service location suits everything from quick weekday lunches to group dinners, with takeout also available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and serves as the primary evidence source. The features section explicitly lists 'Take Out', 'Wireless Internet', and 'Wi-Fi', and the about/contact pages confirm the Sidney address (9842 Resthaven Dr) and phone (250-656-6862) that are absent from the OSM record. No bike parking, water refill, or washroom information appears anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM record contains no address or phone; both values sourced from website only, so cross-check against OSM was not possible.

Website lists three additional Victoria locations under a 'Group Restaurants' section, suggesting this may be part of a small local chain; the Sidney location at 9842 Resthaven Dr appears to be the original site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active full-service Japanese restaurant in Sidney, BC with confirmed takeout and Wi-Fi; a practical dining stop for touring cyclists on the Saanich Peninsula.
